parts.1:
Test One. There are five parts to the test. You will hear each piece twice. We will now stop for a moment before we start the test. Please ask any questions now because you must NOT speak during the test.
PART 1
Now look at the instructions for Part One.
For each question, choose the correct answer.
Question 1
One. How did the woman travel to work this morning?
Man: Hi, you're late for work today.
Woman: Yes, I couldn't use my car – it's at the garage.
Man: So, did you get the train?
Woman: Well, I was on my way to the station, but got on the wrong bus. It took me to the university instead. I was looking at my phone and didn't notice. Then I had to get another one to get here.
Now listen again.
[repeat]
Question 2
Two. What will the man eat first at the restaurant?
Woman: The menu looks really good. What are you going to have?
Man: Well, I want roast chicken for the main course, but I'll have the mushroom soup for my first course.
Woman: I'll have the chicken too, but I'll have salad to start.
Man: I had that last time, but I'm really hungry today. Right, so we're ready to order.
Now listen again.
[repeat]
Question 3
Three. Which was the view from the woman's hotel room?
Man: Good holiday?
Woman: Fantastic, thanks. The hotel was by the beach. It had a beautiful garden. Here's a photo.
Man: Amazing view! I'd love to wake up in a hotel room and see that beach.
Woman: Well, my room was on the other side of the hotel, opposite the pool. I walked along the beach every day, and around the garden too.
Now listen again.
[repeat]
Question 4
Four. Why will the man miss the concert tonight?
Woman: Are you ready to leave soon? The concert starts at 7. Oh no, you look really pale. Have you got a bad headache?
Man: There's something wrong with my tooth. It really hurts.
Woman: What about taking some medicine for the pain?
Man: No, thanks, that'll give me a stomach ache.
Woman: OK, well, let me try and get a doctor's appointment for you.
Now listen again.
[repeat]
Question 5
Five. What will the woman wear for the party?
Woman: I'm trying to decide what to wear for the party. What do you think of this jumper?
Man: It looks great, but won't you be too warm? What about your favourite dress?
Woman: I'm not sure. Everyone else will probably be in jeans and T-shirts.
Man: You don't have to wear what everyone else wears!
Woman: Yes, you're right! I'll take your advice!
Now listen again.
[repeat]
That is the end of Part One.
parts.2:
PART 2
Now look at Part Two.
For each question, write the correct answer in the gap. Write one word or a number or a date or a time. Look at questions 6–10 now. You have ten seconds.
You will hear a man giving information about a city bus tour.
Man: Welcome to City Bus Tours. My name's Greg and we'll start our tour at ten o'clock. There's another tour at one thirty and a final one at twenty past four. There are lots of people this morning, so it might be better to do a later tour instead. If you decide to do that, you need to know the colour of the bus stop. Wait at the blue one – the green stop's for the normal city buses, not tourist buses.
Some of you've asked how long the tour takes. It's about 90 minutes, and I'll talk for around 40 minutes of that to tell you about the city.
Don't lose your bus ticket, as you can use it to get a discount at one of the most interesting places in the city – that's the museum behind the stadium.
You need to know where the tour finishes. As you can see, we're outside the university now, and the last place we'll see is the theatre. From there you can easily get to the river.
Now listen again.
[repeat]
That is the end of Part Two.
parts.3:
PART 3
Now look at Part Three.
For each question, choose the correct answer. Look at questions 11–15 now. You have twenty seconds.
You will hear two friends, Richard and Barbara, talking about a new supermarket.
Richard: Have you been to the new supermarket, Barbara?
Barbara: Yes, Richard, it's great!
Richard: I went this morning. And I couldn't believe it's so large when you get inside!
Barbara: Were there many people?
Richard: Not really. But it was early.
Barbara: And you can save money on your shopping.
Richard: Yeah. Every week, there are special offers on one kind of food, like meat for example. It's fruit at the moment.
Barbara: And next week it might be … vegetables?
Richard: I suppose.
Barbara: So, what did you like best?
Richard: Well, one of the staff told me about the café, but I didn't have enough time to go. People don't usually like the songs they hear in supermarkets, but I loved them there!
Barbara: Me too.
Richard: But I had a problem.
Barbara: You had to wait to pay?
Richard: Not really. I had to pay by cash, but I prefer using my credit card.
Barbara: What a shame.
Richard: Did you use the car park?
Barbara: Yes, I found it easily. You have to walk a long way to get to the supermarket, but at least anybody can park all day.
Now listen again.
[repeat]
That is the end of Part Three.
parts.4:
PART 4
Now look at Part Four.
For each question, choose the correct answer.
Question 16
Sixteen. You will hear a woman talking on the radio about her job. What's her job?
Woman: I guess I've always enjoyed either building or taking things apart – ever since I was a little girl. As a teenager, I loved nothing more than helping my dad fix vehicles or working in his garage. So, it wasn't a big surprise when I chose a career where I design and build planes. I've had an amazing time so far.
Now listen again.
[repeat]
Question 17
Seventeen. You will hear a woman talking to a friend about a film. What does she say about the film?
Man: Have you seen any good films recently?
Woman: Yes, last week. I usually watch comedies, but I wanted to watch something different, so I chose a horror film – I was a bit afraid some of the time!
Man: It still sounds like a good film, but I prefer ones that are based on facts.
Woman: Well, this one certainly wasn't!
Now listen again.
[repeat]
Question 18
Eighteen. You will hear a sports coach talking to some footballers. What would the coach like them to become better at?
Man: You did much better in last Saturday's match. Well done for scoring two goals! They were a great team and you almost beat them. What you need to improve is moving fast around the field when you've got the ball. That's what we'll practise today. I'm going to divide you into four small teams and we'll work together to do this.
Now listen again.
[repeat]
Question 19
Nineteen. You will hear two friends talking about a website. Why does Julia prefer to buy clothes from the website?
Man: That's a nice sweater, Julia.
Woman: Thanks, it's from HighFashion.com – I always order from there.
Man: Their men's clothes are all right, if you don't mind wearing stuff that isn't very popular anymore.
Woman: I don't care about that because everything's at least half-price. But orders can take a while before I get them in the mail.
Man: Yeah, other sites are faster that way.
Now listen again.
[repeat]
Question 20
Twenty. You will hear two colleagues talking together. Why was the man not at the meeting this morning?
Man: How was the meeting this morning, Charlotte?
Woman: Good. But why weren't you there? Did you have a dentist's appointment or something?
Man: That's tomorrow. But one of our most important customers was ill yesterday – he had a terrible earache – so he wanted to see me today. Unfortunately, that meant missing the meeting.
Woman: OK. Well, let me tell you what we discussed.
Now listen again.
[repeat]
That is the end of Part Four.
parts.5:
PART 5
Now look at Part Five.
For each question, choose the correct answer. Look at questions 21–25 now. You have fifteen seconds.
You will hear Gregory talking to Angelika about some things he has bought for his new house. What is he going to put in each place?
Angelika: Where are you going to put all these things, Gregory?
Gregory: I like eating in the garden when it's hot, Angelika, so this table's going outside.
Angelika: I thought it was for your dining room.
Gregory: I've already got a table in there. I got this little light to go on it.
Angelika: That'll look good – it's the same colour as the curtains already in there.
Gregory: That's true.
Angelika: Did you get something to go in your bathroom, too? This mirror, maybe.
Gregory: The wooden chair, actually. I think it'll look good next to the bath.
Angelika: Nice idea. And what about your bedroom?
Gregory: I thought about putting this bookcase in there. But I think this little cupboard will look nicer than the bookcase.
Angelika: There's a space in the living room, a perfect place for the bookcase, you know, under the mirror.
Gregory: That's a good idea.
Angelika: Yes, do you think the kitchen's a good place to put this clock?
Gregory: That's a present for my parents, actually.
Angelika: Oh! But there's lots of light in there, so why don't you put the mirror in there?
Gregory: Good idea!
Now listen again.
[repeat]
That is the end of Part Five.
You now have six minutes to write your answers on the answer sheet.
[ping]
You have one more minute.
[ping]
That is the end of the test.

explanations.p1q1: 汽车在修理厂，她原本要坐火车，却上错公交车，最后仍乘公交车到达，因此选择 C。女士说 "I was on my way to the station, but got on the wrong bus. It took me to the university instead."，说明她没有坐成火车；汽车不能开是因为 "it's at the garage"（在修理厂），是干扰信息。
explanations.p1q2: 男士主菜想吃烤鸡，但第一道菜会先喝蘑菇汤，因此选择 C。他说 "I want roast chicken for the main course, but I'll have the mushroom soup for my first course."；女士提议两人先吃沙拉，但男士回答 "I had that last time, but I'm really hungry today."，可见沙拉不是他的选择。
explanations.p1q3: 酒店临海且有花园，但她的房间在另一侧、正对游泳池，因此选择 B。她说 "my room was on the other side of the hotel, opposite the pool."；海滩和花园是酒店环境，她只是每天去那里散步："I walked along the beach every day, and around the garden too."，都不是从房间看到的景色。
explanations.p1q4: 男士不是头痛或胃痛，而是牙齿疼，因此选择 B。他说 "There's something wrong with my tooth. It really hurts."；女士猜 "Have you got a bad headache?" 是干扰，而男士还担心吃止痛药会 "give me a stomach ache"（胃痛）。
explanations.p1q5: 她最终接受建议，决定穿自己最喜欢的连衣裙，因此选择 A。男士问 "What about your favourite dress?"，她最后说 "Yes, you're right! I'll take your advice!"；她起初犹豫是因为觉得大家都会穿 "jeans and T-shirts"（牛仔裤和 T 恤）。
explanations.p2q1: 正确答案是 4.20。Greg 介绍 "we'll start our tour at ten o'clock. There's another tour at one thirty and a final one at twenty past four."，末班车 "a final one at twenty past four" 即下午 4:20；10 点和 1:30 都是前面的班次，不是最后一班的出发时间。
explanations.p2q2: 正确答案是 blue。Greg 说 "Wait at the blue one – the green stop's for the normal city buses, not tourist buses."，观光巴士要在蓝色站牌等；绿色站牌是普通城市公交的，是主要干扰项。
explanations.p2q3: 正确答案是 90。原文 "It's about 90 minutes, and I'll talk for around 40 minutes of that to tell you about the city."，整个行程约 90 分钟；40 只是 Greg 讲解所占的时间，是干扰数字。
explanations.p2q4: 正确答案是 museum。Greg 说 "you can use it to get a discount at one of the most interesting places in the city – that's the museum behind the stadium."，凭车票可以在体育场后面的博物馆享受折扣；"Don't lose your bus ticket" 只是提醒别丢票，不是答案内容。
explanations.p2q5: 正确答案是 theatre。原文 "the last place we'll see is the theatre. From there you can easily get to the river."，行程的最后一站是剧院；大学是现在出发的位置（"we're outside the university now"），河流是剧院之后可步行到达的地方，都不是终点。
explanations.p3q1: Richard 没想到超市里面这么大，因此选择 A。他说 "I couldn't believe it's so large when you get inside!"；人不多不是让他吃惊的点——"Not really. But it was early."，而开门时间原文并未提及。
explanations.p3q2: 每周优惠品类不同，本周是水果，因此选择 B。Richard 说 "there are special offers on one kind of food, like meat for example. It's fruit at the moment."；meat 只是举例，vegetables 是 Barbara 猜测的下周可能："And next week it might be … vegetables?"
explanations.p3q3: 他没时间去咖啡厅，但很喜欢超市里的音乐，因此选择 C。他说 "People don't usually like the songs they hear in supermarkets, but I loved them there!"；café 他没去成："I didn't have enough time to go."，工作人员只是跟他聊过咖啡厅而已。
explanations.p3q4: 他只能付现金，无法使用自己更习惯的信用卡，因此选择 C。他说 "I had to pay by cash, but I prefer using my credit card."；Barbara 猜他排队等付款（"You had to wait to pay?"），他回答 "Not really."，所以等待不是问题。
explanations.p3q5: Barbara 说停车场离入口有一段距离，因此选择 B。她说 "You have to walk a long way to get to the supermarket, but at least anybody can park all day."；停车场很好找（"I found it easily."），而且谁都能停（"anybody can park all day"），并非只限顾客。
explanations.p4q1: 正确答案是 engineer。女士说 "I chose a career where I design and build planes."，从事设计并制造飞机的职业，即工程师；她小时候帮父亲修车 "helping my dad fix vehicles or working in his garage" 只是引出职业的经历，不是 mechanic（机械修理师）；全文没有提到她开飞机。
explanations.p4q2: 正确答案是 It was scary. 女士选了恐怖片并说 "I was a bit afraid some of the time!"；她平时才看喜剧（"I usually watch comedies"），这部电影并没有逗她笑；男士喜欢基于真实故事的电影，女士答 "this one certainly wasn't!"，所以它不是 true。
explanations.p4q3: 正确答案是 running with the ball。教练说 "What you need to improve is moving fast around the field when you've got the ball."，需要提高的是带球快速跑动；进球已经不错（"Well done for scoring two goals!"），不是要改进的方面；把队员分成四组（"divide you into four small teams"）只是训练的组织方式。
explanations.p4q4: 正确答案是 The discounts are excellent. Julia 说 "everything's at least half-price"，东西全是半价以下，所以她不在乎款式；恰恰相反，网站的款式 "isn't very popular anymore"（已不流行），而送货是弱点："orders can take a while before I get them in the mail."，所以不是送达快。
explanations.p4q5: 正确答案是 He had other work to do. 男士说一位重要客户病了要见他："he wanted to see me today. Unfortunately, that meant missing the meeting."，因工作错过了会议；牙医预约是明天（"That's tomorrow."），是干扰项；生病的是客户，不是他自己不舒服。
explanations.p5q1: dining room 对应 lamp（E）。Gregory 说 "I've already got a table in there. I got this little light to go on it."，餐厅已有桌子，新买的小灯要放在餐桌上；table 将放到花园（"this table's going outside"），curtains 是餐厅里原本就有的（"the curtains already in there"）。
explanations.p5q2: bathroom 对应 seat（G）。Angelika 提议放镜子，Gregory 却说 "The wooden chair, actually. I think it'll look good next to the bath."，浴室里要放的是木椅；mirror 起初被提议但没有放浴室，最后放进了厨房。
explanations.p5q3: bedroom 对应 cupboard（C）。Gregory 说 "I thought about putting this bookcase in there. But I think this little cupboard will look nicer than the bookcase."，卧室最终放小橱柜；bookcase 则被安排到客厅。
explanations.p5q4: living room 对应 bookcase（A）。Angelika 指出 "There's a space in the living room, a perfect place for the bookcase, you know, under the mirror."，客厅镜子下面的空位正适合放书架，Gregory 表示赞同（"That's a good idea."）。
explanations.p5q5: kitchen 对应 mirror（F）。Angelika 建议说 "there's lots of light in there, so why don't you put the mirror in there?"，厨房光线好适合放镜子，Gregory 称赞 "Good idea!"；clock 是给父母的礼物（"That's a present for my parents, actually."），不会留在自己厨房。
